text:
Zara Kim: Quick idea  tie a few leftover spot-award funds to the Mentorship Program. We have ~$450 unallocated from last quarter. Want to discuss process here.

Ben Wallace: Nice reuse of funds. How many spot awards are we thinking and budget per award?

Zara Kim: Thinking 3 mentorship spot awards at $125 each (covers e-gift + a small mentor kit). Leaves a small buffer for tax/admin.

Priya Nair: Finance sign-off needed; also need to confirm these are taxable/needs paperwork for mentors. I'll check.

HR-Bot: Created a short nomination form: https://forms.gle/mentor-spot-2026 (fields: mentee nominator, mentor nominee, program cohort, short reason, opt-in for reward)

Omar Diaz: Can mentees nominate their mentors? I think that's the point. Also can managers nominate mentors who run groups?

Zara Kim: Yes to both. Primary nominations should come from mentees but managers can nominate too if they saw sustained impact.

Kelsey Wu: Suggest a simple rubric: mentorship quality (1-4), growth impact (1-4), consistency (1-4). Avg score picks winners. Keeps it transparent.

Priya Nair: Finance: initial check shows gift cards below $600 per recipient are simple, but we need recipient emails. I'll also need a short note on why mentorship awards (for audit).

Ben Wallace: I can help collect nominee emails and assemble the payout list once winners chosen.

HR-Bot: Reminder set: "Mentor Spot Awards nominations close" will post in #general 3 days before close and day-of.

Zara Kim: Action items:
- Zara: add rubric and guidance to the form (today)
- Priya: confirm tax treatment and approval path with Finance (today)
- Ben: prepare payout sheet template and payment emails column
- Omar/Kelsey: volunteer to review nominations (panel)

Omar Diaz: I'll take the review lead. Can we set a quick 30-min review slot next Monday?

Kelsey Wu: Works for me  put it on the calendar.

Zara Kim: One more thing: offer winners a "mentor spotlight" on the All-Hands slide + a short quote from the nominator. Keeps it personal.

Priya Nair: Sounds good. I'll loop Finance after finalists. Also will confirm whether mentor kit (swag) needs procurement approval.

Ben Wallace: I'll create the shared sheet and post the link here when ready.

Zara Kim: Thanks team  closing thread, will post form update shortly. :sparkles:
